description:
Parleshwar Katta (Edition 4, October 2026) is the Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar’s community magazine on art, culture and dialogue, written in Marathi and English.
Highlights:
A Marathi tribute to Nana Patekar’s stage and film career and his NAAM work for farmers
An editorial on mechanical WhatsApp greetings
The Parle-G factory in Vile Parle East being demolished
Two AI essays: Uday Sanghani on human judgement, and Amar Pandit on staying optimistic
Dharmesh Vala on recency bias and asset cycles
Milind Gunaji on Avchitgad and Ghosalgad forts
A cyber-safety warning about 1980s photo-trend apps
Pieces on mood foods, elder care, Paryushan and Natsamrat
Local sports wins, Ganeshotsav photos, Rotary school projects, horoscopes and many local ads
It also promotes the Kaladarpan Art & Culture Fest on 12–13 December 2026.
